name: mo-agent-memory
description: Expose mo-agent-runtime memory recall, memory CRUD, and lifecycle hooks as a host-loadable OpenClaw plugin package.
author: MatrixOne Team

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Recall relevant memory snippets for a query.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Delete one memory by ID or by query lookup.

tools.name: memory_update
tools.description: Update text/category/importance for an existing memory item.

hooks.name: before_prompt_build
hooks.description: Modern OpenClaw prompt hook that prepends relevant memories via prependContext.

hooks.name: before_agent_start
hooks.description: Legacy compatibility hook that mirrors the prompt-memory prepend payload.

hooks.name: agent_end
hooks.description: Optional auto-capture hook that stores selected conversation turns.

autoRecall.description: Automatically recall relevant memories before prompt assembly.

autoCapture.description: Automatically capture selected conversation messages at agent_end.

recallLimit.description: Maximum memory snippets injected into the prompt.

recallMaxTokens.description: Token budget forwarded to mo-agent memory retrieval.

captureMaxItems.description: Maximum unique messages stored during auto-capture.

defaultTaskType.description: Fallback mo-agent task type when the host does not provide one.

embeddingProvider.description: Embedding backend used by the Python memory retriever. OpenAI uses text-embedding-3-small in the current implementation.

pythonExecutable.description: Python interpreter used by the packaged bridge.

runtimeRoot.description: Optional path to a mo-agent-runtime checkout so the bridge can import core.context and sdk modules.

defaultUserId.description: Fallback user id for stored memories when the host does not provide one.
